epics.title: Canonical V2 and residual WordPress runtime safety
epics.acceptance: Canonical OpenSpec, executable safety regression coverage and explicit external deployment blocker are verified; every merged change follows exact-SHA CI and guarded branch cleanup.

stories.title: Reconcile canonical OpenSpec and generated tooling
stories.acceptance: Official CLI-managed integration is verified or documented as not needed; bootstrap safety requirements are canonical, nonduplicate and strict-validated.

tasks.title: Review CLI-generated integration (O04)
tasks.acceptance: Any generated integration committed was produced by an actual openspec init/update and its source is recorded; nothing is hand-crafted.

subtasks.title: Run the official CLI on a disposable environment; compare outputs with tracked integration and document the result.
subtasks.acceptance: CLI invocation and exact generated diff or evidence of no required update are recorded.

tasks.title: Reconcile archived bootstrap-safety delta (O05)
tasks.acceptance: Relevant behavior from archived changes is represented once in current stable OpenSpec; official strict validation passes.

subtasks.title: Compare archived bootstrap-safety spec to current stable spec and inventory overlaps or missing assertions.
subtasks.acceptance: Diff review and requirement provenance are recorded without resurrecting legacy changes.

stories.title: Bound runtime security claims and deployment verification
stories.acceptance: Known residual C08 detection gaps are identified and tested within a bounded source scope; external legacy-deployment verification stays blocked without deployment evidence.

tasks.title: Bounded dynamic-execution regression analysis (C08)
tasks.acceptance: Bootstrap-reachable first-party paths are enumerated; regression fixtures and real WordPress checks cover the documented cases without claiming full PHP-parser security.

subtasks.title: Map remaining dynamic includes, reflection, non-hook callables and each relevant source-reachable edge.
subtasks.acceptance: A traceable negative/benign fixture matrix covers verified paths and records unproven cases.

tasks.title: Verify legacy deployment does not expose source exporter (S06)
tasks.acceptance: Only after an authorized deployment target and current release are supplied, independently verify exporter and source-report endpoints cannot be read anonymously; otherwise remain blocked.

subtasks.title: Request an authorized deployment/release reference and run a bounded unauthenticated exposure check without secrets.
subtasks.acceptance: Timestamped external evidence or an explicit no-deployment blocker is recorded.

constraints: No Composer or vendor mutation at runtime

epics.title: Evidence-based dependency consolidation decision
epics.acceptance: A recorded, evidence-backed go/no-go decision exists for A local vendor, B offline read-only comparison, or C isolated CLI-only assessment; unsafe global runtime merging remains prohibited.

stories.title: Establish measured demand without runtime scans
stories.acceptance: Any real dependency-unification need is supported by authorized, reproducible evidence; absent evidence causes a recorded no-go.

tasks.title: Identify verifiable dependency-conflict use case (D01)
tasks.acceptance: Record a named use case, affected plugin and measured cross-plugin conflict, or explicitly record that the need remains unverified.

subtasks.title: Define a privacy-safe evidence schema for supplied manifest and lock metadata.
subtasks.acceptance: The evidence template rejects secrets, filesystem scans and unsupported assertions.

tasks.title: Run bounded offline read-only comparison (D01)
tasks.acceptance: Only explicitly supplied manifests/lockfiles are compared offline, with an explained version/conflict matrix; no production plugin scan occurs.

subtasks.title: Check supplied metadata for semver incompatibilities in an isolated read-only test fixture.
subtasks.acceptance: The resulting table records actual constraints, versions, provenance and unknowns.

external_wait.resume_condition: At least two distinct owner-authorized, sanitized, provenance-attributed Composer metadata inputs (plugin slug, source SHA, constraints, lock versions) are supplied and independently validated; neither live plugin scan nor automatic mutation is allowed.

stories.title: Design safe alternatives and owner decision
stories.acceptance: A/B/C options are reviewed against isolation, semver, load order, rollback, authorization and concurrency; no global runtime consolidation is authorized.

tasks.title: Assess safe architecture and transaction gates (C02/D02)
tasks.acceptance: Review local autoload, offline read-only comparison and opt-in sandboxed CLI alternatives, including conflict isolation, rollback, concurrency and atomicity.

subtasks.title: Produce a testable threat/conflict/rollback matrix with a fail-closed default.
subtasks.acceptance: The matrix records mandatory preconditions, rejection cases and safe cancellation.

tasks.title: Record go/no-go decision (D01/D02)
tasks.acceptance: Document the selected option and explicit named-owner authorization, or retain local vendor as a measured no-go; implementation is not automatically approved.

subtasks.title: Present source-backed alternatives and capture the decision boundary.
subtasks.acceptance: Decision states permitted scope and requires a separate approved OpenSpec change before application code changes.

constraints: No live scan of installed plugins
Separate authorization for any CLI-only prototype

epics.title: WordPress/PHP compatibility and reproducible packaging
epics.acceptance: Verified version and deployment compatibility evidence, reproducible Composer artifacts and a conditional vendor-retention decision are available; no implicit production deployment.

stories.title: Verify actual support and compatibility
stories.acceptance: Actual deployment versions and current supported software constraints are recorded and tested; no unverified PHP/WordPress minimum upgrade is imposed.

tasks.title: Verify deployed PHP, WordPress and Composer versions (D03)
tasks.acceptance: Record authorized deployed version evidence or clearly report unknowns; compare with declared composer.json and official support matrix.

subtasks.title: Collect a source-backed version matrix without requiring production credentials in the repository.
subtasks.acceptance: Version evidence includes source, observation date, runtime/manifest distinction and unsupported cases.

tasks.title: Run isolated compatibility regression matrix (D03)
tasks.acceptance: Relevant PHP 8+ and WordPress test combinations pass or have documented failures; release decision is grounded in exact results.

subtasks.title: Execute the supported plugin bootstrap/activation integration tests on isolated known-version environments.
subtasks.acceptance: Results and safe failure handling are linked to exact commits and versions.

external_wait.resume_condition: E-PU-V2-003-S1-T1 must have verified authorized target PHP/WordPress/Composer versions before exact integration test targets are selected.

stories.title: Decide reproducible Composer package strategy
stories.acceptance: A clean local Composer build can reproduce expected artifacts and restore plugin-local autoload; committed vendor removal remains conditional on a verified delivery strategy.

tasks.title: Reproduce composer.lock install and deploy artifact (C03)
tasks.acceptance: Clean-build reproduction, immutable lock resolution, artifact inventory and WordPress-local autoload recovery are evidenced.

subtasks.title: Rebuild the locked dependency artifact in isolation and compare packaged files and bootstrap tests.
subtasks.acceptance: Artifacts and failure/rollback checks have traceable test output and exact source SHA.

tasks.title: Gate optional removal of committed vendor directory (C03)
tasks.acceptance: Do not remove tracked vendor unless reproducibility, installation/deployment plan, recovery and rollback are independently verified and approved.

subtasks.title: Document keep-vs-remove tradeoffs using test results and a separate owner approval gate.
subtasks.acceptance: No vendor removal occurs in this epic without a new approved OpenSpec change and release plan.

constraints: Vendor removal only with verified artifact and explicit approval

global_quality_gate: Every implementation requires separate explicit approval; exact PR-head official OpenSpec, runtime safety and independent dependency-security PASS, guarded merge to main and exact registered branch cleanup.
